svg.title: 5G NR Frequency Bands (FR1 + FR2)
svg.desc: Interactive pure-CSS/SVG chart of 3GPP 5G New Radio frequency bands by duplex mode. Data source: Wikipedia, 5G NR frequency bands.
svg.text: hover a band for detail · hover a legend chip to isolate a mode
use ◀ ▶ to move along the spectrum · ⟲ back to start
